description: Quotes or makes a standalone audio track in Create: either a voice-over read by ElevenLabs Eleven v4 (kind 'voice', with optional kept or stock voice) or an instrumental music bed (kind 'music'). With run false nothing is spent and it returns the estimated token price. Spends tokens when run is true.

kind.description: 'voice' for a spoken voice-over, or 'music' for an instrumental music bed.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

run.description: true to spend tokens and generate the track; false (default) only quotes.

seconds.description: Target length in seconds (5–300 for voice, 10–180 for music).

voice.description: Voice name or voiceId (for kind 'voice'; omit for Brian).

words.description: What the voice-over says or is about, or the music's style, mood, instruments and tempo.

name: sound_make
title: Make voice or music
